interpretation: This is a byte-for-byte replay of retained post-AEC uplink samples; it does not use the physical network or make a new acoustic measurement.
VAD opening proves the double-talk interval was not merely too quiet. Its semantic destruction and failure to close prove the remaining profile-3 defect matters to the production provider contract.
This result selects the one-variable 24 dB to 18 dB microphone-headroom experiment. It does not justify a gain expander or a looser acoustic threshold.
